name: video-ads-claude-code
title_zh: 单人视频广告全流程，从钩子到投放复盘一个 Agent
tagline_zh: 一个人当整支广告团队：从商业发现、留存调研到脚本分镜、配音选乐、生成提示词，最后还带投放学习。
tagline_en: Solo video ads: discovery, retention research, hooks, scripts, storyboards, voice, music, prompts, assembly, and.
desc_en: Create and improve video advertising as solo Claude Code, with an integrated second brain for business discovery, retention research on video that already runs, hooks, scripts, storyboards, voice direction, music, generation prompting, assembly and campaign learning. Use for one-assistant video ad work; use the team edition when both Claude Code and Codex are requested.
why_zh: 内置第二大脑，把「调研-创作-复盘」串成闭环；不是零散提示词，而是按广告生命周期组织的完整工作流。
why_en: Built-in second brain ties research, creation, and review into a closed loop—not scattered prompts but a lifecycle-shaped ad.
limit_zh: 只服务视频广告创作与优化，不覆盖平面素材、落地页或投放后台操作。
limit_en: Video ad creation/optimization only; no static ads, landing pages, or ad-account ops. Requires Claude Code + video-gen API keys. Team edition needed.
title_en: One-agent video ad pipeline: hooks to campaign learning.
